chunks: He said: "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord but those who go astray?"
ai.seo_question: Who despairs of God's mercy according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to Surah Yusuf, emphasizing that persistent despair is a spiritual blindness distinct from mere sinning. It serves as a vital encouragement for believers to maintain hope in Allah's mercy, regardless of their sins, while warning that those who lose hope have truly gone astray.
